findings.description: REMEDIATION INEFFECTIVE: commit 4be2e1d flips a key the gate does not read, with a value the gate would refuse anyway, so the spot scored-execution authority gate REMAINS FAIL-CLOSED at the audited bytes. (1) WRONG LOCATION: require_scored_authority (research/assets/forex_ng1/spot_series.py:341-373) calls spot_authority_status(), which returns proof['authority_status'], and then reads block.get('scored_consumption') -- i.e. authority_status.scored_consumption, which 4be2e1d left at 'CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED'. The remediation instead added a TOP-LEVEL 'scored_consumption' key; a repo-wide grep shows NO code reads the top-level key (the only readers are spot_series.py and build_artifacts.py:581, both of the authority_status block). (2) WRONG VALUE: spot_series.py:368 requires scored == 'AUTHORIZED' exactly and accounting.compute_outcomes (research/assets/forex_ng1/run/accounting.py:74) requires spot_authority == 'AUTHORIZED' exactly -- the recorded 'AUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_RESEARCH' fails both even if relocated (attempt-1 had already flagged this for the ruling string; the remediation reused it). (3) EXECUTED PROOF: A7 ran require_scored_authority() from detached tree /tmp/a7p2_forex_ng1 at 4be2e1d (root .venv, cwd=tree, default proof path resolving INSIDE the tree -- committed bytes, no env/session state): raises SpotAuthorityError "spot channel scored_consumption='CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED': scored consumption refused (fail-closed...)". The test at tests/test_forex_ng1_p1spot.py:313 shows the intended flip shape: authority_status.scored_consumption == 'AUTHORIZED'. (4) CONSEQUENCE: identical to A7-NG1-H1 -- GO on these bytes deterministically refuses all six budget cells in E (wasted one-shot); a later mid-E flip would be authorization-after-peeking. (5) AGGRAVATING HYGIENE: the artifact is now internally contradictory (verdict line still '...NOT AUTHORIZED FOR SCORED CONSUMPTION: DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE / CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED'; authority_status.scored_consumption='CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED'; new top-level key='AUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_RESEARCH'), and authority_enforcement.a7_prelaunch_finding_addressed claims the flip 'is the mechanical remedy A7 prescribed' -- it is not: attempt-1 and the artifact's own owner_decision_required field both prescribe setting authority_status.scored_consumption. A later reader could mistake the top-level key for an effective authorization. FIX BEFORE GO (not by A7): inside the SAME committed artifact, set authority_status.scored_consumption to the exact string 'AUTHORIZED' (per the artifact's own prescription and the code contract), keep the authority_enforcement block and basis, and resolve the contradiction explicitly (supersede or update the verdict/status wording); commit BEFORE the GO key is typed; append the matching event. No re-run of the technical chain is required by this finding.
